subject: Post-call: BluePeak encryption & SOC2 intake — next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claudia Rossi <claudia.rossi@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: BluePeak encryption & SOC2 intake — next steps

Hi Claudia,

Thanks again for the time earlier — good conversation. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Summary of ask: you are evaluating how Redwood would handle encryption for PHI and R&D data, and whether you can retain key control (BYOK/CMK) for regulatory records. You also asked about our SOC 2 status and what evidence we can share for a security review.

- Short answers up front: Redwood supports TLS in transit and AES-256 at rest. We offer customer-managed keys via our KMS integrations and an HSM-backed option for Dedicated/Private deployments (we can share architecture diagrams). SOC 2 Type II report available (we provide redacted copies on NDA).

- Next steps I propose:
  1) Please complete the attached high-level security questionnaire so we can triage any gaps (attached: BluePeak_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx).
  2) We will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II and a short architecture note that describes our BYOK and HSM options.
  3) If you can confirm the expected deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), we can map the exact control surface and KMS flow.

Could you confirm who on your side should get the questionnaire (security team or technical ops)? If useful, we can also schedule a short follow-up with our security engineer to walk through the BYOK flow.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: BluePeak_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx
From: Claudia Rossi <claudia.rossi@bluepeak.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@bluepeak.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 17:45:12 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: BluePeak encryption & SOC2 intake — next steps

Thanks Hannah — that recap is perfect. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- Please send the questionnaire to security@bluepeak.com and cc me. Liam from infra should be on the thread for the KMS details.
- Important constraints: our CRO has asked that any PHI-related workloads must have customer-controlled keys stored in an HSM or equivalent FIPS 140-2 level 3 equivalent. We expect to see a diagram of the key flow for both Hosted and Dedicated options.
- SOC 2: we can sign an NDA to receive the redacted report.

We’ll start the questionnaire and aim to return a completed copy by EOD Friday. In the meantime, could your team confirm whether Redwood's BYOK supports AWS CloudHSM as an external key store, or if the current integration is limited to AWS KMS?

Best,
Claudia Rossi
Security Program Manager
BluePeak Therapeutics
claudia.rossi@bluepeak.com

On Tue, May 4, 2027 at 15:12, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Claudia,
> 
> Thanks again for the time earlier — good conversation. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: ...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 02:30:45 +0000
Subject: FW: BluePeak encryption follow-up — AWS CloudHSM question

Hannah / Priyom — moving this internal so we can respond with specifics. Notes: 

- AWS CloudHSM: Our Hosted offering does not directly accept CloudHSM as an external key store today. Hosted supports customer-managed keys via customer KMS (AWS KMS with CMKs) where the CMK policies restrict usage. For HSM-backed BYOK we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment where we can place an HSM (CloudHSM or on-prem HSM) inside the customer's VPC; that path allows the customer to have exclusive key custody and FIPS-validated HSMs.

- Evidence: attaching the redacted SOC 2 Type II (2024) for BluePeak intake — we require the customer NDA before full unredacted copies. The attachment includes the sections BluePeak requested about encryption and key management.

- Suggested reply to Claudia: acknowledge CloudHSM limitation for Hosted, outline Dedicated/Private HSM architecture, offer to schedule a 30-min technical deep dive with our infra/security engineer (Priyom) to show the key flow diagrams and to confirm FIPS level of supported HSMs. Also clarify timeline to provide diagrams (~48 hours).

Action items: 
  - Priyom: can you prepare the HSM diagram and a short note on supported HSM vendors (AWS CloudHSM, Thales Luna Cloud, on-prem HSMs) and confirm FIPS levels? Target: close of day Thu.
  - Hannah: propose the NDA and a follow-up slot; attach the redacted SOC 2 and questionnaire.

Thanks — passing to Priyom for the technical bits.

Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_2024_redacted.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claudia Rossi <claudia.rossi@bluepeak.com>, security@bluepeak.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: BluePeak encryption & SOC2 intake — next steps

Hi Claudia / BluePeak security team,

Thanks for the quick reply. Per Marissa and Priyom's notes above: 

- Hosted vs Dedicated: Hosted does not currently accept external CloudHSM key stores. For strict HSM custody we recommend Dedicated or Private where we can integrate CloudHSM or customer HSMs in the VPC (customer retains key ownership).

- Attachments: I’ve attached the high-level questionnaire (same as earlier) and a redacted SOC 2 Type II. Once we have a signed NDA I can share the unredacted report and more detailed artifact packages.

- Next steps / ask from you: please confirm that security@bluepeak.com will be the intake point for completed questionnaire and whether Liam should be added to the doc permissions.

- Technical deep dive: Priyom is available for a 30-min technical session on Thursday 5/6 between 14:00–17:00 PT. Please let us know a slot that works and we’ll send a calendar invite. The session will cover: key lifecycle (creation, rotation, revocation), network placement, HSM vendors supported, and how we enforce encryption-in-use/at-rest protections for PHI.

Looking forward — attaching: BluePeak_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx and SOC2_TypeII_2024_redacted.pdf.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
